headline: Contemporary Chinese Architecture in Continuous Evolution and Transformation: An Interview with Liu Yulong of THAD
context: Thirty years later, the UIA World Congress of Architects returns to Barcelona. Coinciding with the centenary of Antoni Gaudí’s passing, history and the present converge in this city, lending this year’s congress a unique depth of meaning.
